      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/CreditBalance/InitializeAccount/ACCOUNT_SEED_NONNEGATIVE@8b776d5f39a42aff

  def checkEventPostconditions(events: List[Event]): Option[iMadzError] =
    events.iterator.map(checkEventPostcondition).collectFirst { case Some(error) => error }

  private def checkEventPostcondition(event: Event): Option[iMadzError] = event match {
    case e: AccountInitialized =>
      if (Option(e.resource).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "AccountInitialized.resource 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.currency).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "AccountInitialized.currency 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.amount).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "AccountInitialized.amount 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: ReserveFundsConfirmed =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "ReserveFundsConfirmed.txid 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.resource).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "ReserveFundsConfirmed.resource 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.amount).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "ReserveFundsConfirmed.amount 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.currency).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "ReserveFundsConfirmed.currency 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.available).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "ReserveFundsConfirmed.available 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: DeductFundsConfirmed =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "DeductFundsConfirmed.txid 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.resource).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "DeductFundsConfirmed.resource 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.amount).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "DeductFundsConfirmed.amount 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: ReleaseReservedFundsConfirmed =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "ReleaseReservedFundsConfirmed.txid 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.resource).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "ReleaseReservedFundsConfirmed.resource 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.amount).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "ReleaseReservedFundsConfirmed.amount 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.currency).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "ReleaseReservedFundsConfirmed.currency 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.available).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "ReleaseReservedFundsConfirmed.available 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: RecordIncomingCreditsConfirmed =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "RecordIncomingCreditsConfirmed.txid 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.resource).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "RecordIncomingCreditsConfirmed.resource 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.amount).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "RecordIncomingCreditsConfirmed.amount 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: CommitIncomingCreditsConfirmed =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "CommitIncomingCreditsConfirmed.txid 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.resource).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "CommitIncomingCreditsConfirmed.resource 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.amount).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "CommitIncomingCreditsConfirmed.amount 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.currency).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "CommitIncomingCreditsConfirmed.currency 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.available).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "CommitIncomingCreditsConfirmed.available 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: CancelIncomingCreditConfirmed =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "CancelIncomingCreditConfirmed.txid 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.resource).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "CancelIncomingCreditConfirmed.resource 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.amount).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "CancelIncomingCreditConfirmed.amount 不能为空"))
      else None
    case _ => None
  }
}
